slides.headline: London 22–23 Jan
slides.body:
Dave Bradley writes “ We’ve got an event in London (UK) next week, 22–23 Jan, which I think would be of great interest to your group’s members. It’s XR Connects, the VR+AR+MR conference, from the makers of Pocket Gamer Connects. It’s a professional conference for people working in the VR+AR+MR scene. There are talks, panels, workshops, an expo area, meeting system, pitching competition for indie VR game developers, a party etc. Great for networking as well as learning. You can see who’s speaking here: http://www.xrconnects.com/london/speakers/

This exclusive code will give your friends a massive 40% off the ticket price.

Thanks! Dave
